title: Unified rerank variant gating and multilang smoke harness
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: provide a single, auditable gating layer for selecting cross-encoder reranker variants per region/locale and a lightweight smoke/regression harness to detect quality or latency regressions during staged upgrades. Background: we operate several cross-encoder families (huge, compact, quantized) and need a deterministic, measurable way to pick a variant for a traffic segment that balances NDCG quality, 95th p99 latency SLOs, and cost. This ticket builds the gating rules, the per-locale calibration table, and an automated smoke harness that runs canary traffic, computes quality delta against baseline, and triggers rollbacks on thresholds. This work ties into the Dedicated autoscaling policies and the Optimize recommendations for quantization profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Gating layer implemented as a config-driven policy that can route by locale, traffic tier, and latency budget (config stored in config-service and editable via Console)
Per-locale calibration table created for top 30 locales with quality/latency tradeoffs documented
Smoke harness executes daily against canaries: collects NDCG@10, MRR, p95 latency, and token-cost-per-request; results pushed to rerank-regressions dashboard
Automated rollback rule: if NDCG@10 drops > 1.5 absolute points (or >3% relative) OR p95 latency worsens > 50ms for the canary cohort, flag release and pause rollout
Canary rollout recipe in Console: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic wait conditions; PRD and runbook linked
End-to-end test coverage for the gating decision logic and smoke-harness metric collectors (unit + integration)
Documentation: design doc and how-to for SEs to add a new cross-encoder variant to gating matrix
implementation_notes: Decision: use two-stage selection. Stage 1: locale-level candidate set (allowed variants). Stage 2: policy evaluates latency budget and cost cap to pick high-quality or compact variant.
Trade-off: prefer 1.0-1.5% NDCG lift for core locales at cost of +10–15% token-cost; long-tail locales default to compact/quantized to keep p95 latency under SLO
KV/Warmstart: ensure reranker caches (candidate encodings/KV) are warmed for canary cohorts to avoid first-request skew
Batching: harness runs with production-ish batch-size distributions; synthetic single-request tests are insufficient
Model signatures: add metadata for model family, quantization level, expected p95 per-seq-len buckets in model registry
Safety: gating layer will default to existing stable variant on missing metadata or failures
Telemetry: emit gating_decision, baseline_variant, chosen_variant, reason_code, ndcg_delta, p95_latency_delta for each canary run
rollout_plan: Create calibration seeds and evaluation sets per-locale (links in comments)
Implement gating API + config UI toggle (dev -> staging -> prod) behind feature flag rerank.gating.v2
Smoke harness schedule: nightly 00:30 UTC and on every candidate build; run against production-like candidate pools
Canary rollout steps: 1% traffic for 24h -> assess metrics; if green move to 10% for 24h -> 50% for 12h -> 100%
Escalation: pager duty channel rerank-upgrades, runbook with rollback commands and dashboard links
Post-mortem window: collect regression diffs and run deeper offline eval on failure cases
